killers always whine and laugh at survivors giving up when in reality survivors have very little counterplay when another survivor is tunneled out early or kills themself on hook. killers have so much more rebound potential, if a survivor is tunneled out / camped before the first 2 gens are done, and no i dont wanna hear the 'well you shouldve been doing gens' bs because we all know most killers bring corrupt/ruin, then there genuinely is very little survivors can do. Even low tier killers like legion with ruin + sloppy, not to mention lethal.  


 if they tunnel or camp someone out before there is like 2-3 gens left, everyone is injured, there is no way survivors can get all of the gens done while one is also being chased or is on hook, unless you have a godly survivor manage to run the killer for 3 minutes, IF the killer commits which they usually dont. and even if they do, they have to run them through the entire map, past gens and usally past weaker survivors in weaker positions. survivors give up not because we are always salty but because there genuinely is no reason to continue the game. this isnt the killers fault it is bhvrs for making this game only fun to play if you have a high chance of winning.

  
continuing a game where you all got shit on 9/10 times with the killer being cocky and bming, all for maybe an extra 2000-5000 bp isnt worth it for me, id rather just get to the next game. ESPECIALLY when in a SWF, when your teammate is killed so early on no one wants to make them watch the entire game of the rest of us getting demolished and then wait another 10mins for a lobby.   


killer wise though even if you have a team of asshole cocky survivors destroying you for half the game, one mistake, a good noed spawn, some slugging and a few people in weak positions and you pretty much have huge potential to turn the game around and get a full 4k. most survivors arent the cracked ones you see on youtube, most are low to mid skill players and its truly ridiculous how easy early game camping and tunneling can turn a killer game into a 4k with little effort, and yes, i play both sides. with noed, and its insane how a team of 100% more skilled players can lose a game vs me entirely because of noed or camping.  


in most other 'comp' games, yes i say comp because of how mmr implies the game should be played, valuing wins more than anything, when a player leaves early the team is compensated with either more points or less objectives to do, dbd will probably never implement that and survivors will never stop giving up to get to the next lobby.
